suite.description: RN-01: the emitting suite (pipeline stage or fitness check id), e.g. 'pre-merge/9-architecture' or 'FF-03'

case.description: RN-02: the case within the suite (file, module, scenario)

verifies.description: RN-04: the requirement or fitness function this case verifies - FR-*, NFR-*, AS-*, FF-*. Empty means the case verifies nothing and is itself a finding.

artefacts.description: RN-03: links to outputs (report files, logs, images)
